title: LNG news share leads YAR.OL 6d
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] GDELT daily LNG news share z-score > 1 leads YAR.OL returns by 6 days (+) as a daily-frequency gas-input-anxiety substitute for the sparse Crossref series; long YAR.OL 6d [gdelt.gkg.lng_share -> finance.YAR.OL.log_return] (parent: R2-0048)

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.lng_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long YAR next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
